name: Preset: Goldman Sachs 2023
description: Report-replication preset (spec §8.4). Default feasibility, near-unit-elastic output demand with high pass-through of cost savings to prices, historical reinstatement, slightly higher intensity; reproduces GDP about +7% over ten years with employment roughly flat, which is the report's narrative. The v0.3 application layer (embodied automation, output substitution, traded services) is switched off: the study modelled generative AI on tasks only.
